title: Bazel Affected Query
description: How `affected` is answered by Bazel itself: every changed file and every project is a node of one generated package, a project lists the changed files that touch it and the projects it depends on, and `rdeps` over the changed-file nodes returns every project to rebuild. No checkout file is read, so deleted files and untracked files behave like any other change.

Touches.description: The changed files that touch each project directly, by project name.

Answer.description: What the query printed: one label per line.
